q2_gaps: Whether a counted plural filling a NON-subject role (here the Theme of an agentless passive) also takes the per-member distribution rule. The distributive-predicate trigger and every example given for it ('the dogs barked', 'both dogs barked', 'all the students passed') put the group in subject/undergoer position, so a counted group in Theme position is left undetermined - group-only, or group plus a rule over (PartOf $x sk_group_1) carrying the Theme role.
notes: The agentless passive correctly omits the Agent atom, 'sell' correctly takes Theme for its displaced object, 'to the depot' correctly takes Recipient as the goal of a transfer, and the definite 'the depot' correctly mints a typed witness.
